description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (2.69 each) capped at 19999, restores HP (55) to all allies, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Kindred Mode I (Yuna)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Kindred Mode I (Yuna)
description.text: Summoning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Quick Cast 1] and Summoning smart ether 1 to the user after casting Summoning abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants Summoning smart ether 2, [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Kindred Mode II (Yuna)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Kindred Mode II (Yuna)
description.text: Instant cast speed for Summoning abilities, casts Dual Future's Prayer after using Summoning abilities

description.name: Dual Future's Prayer
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [HP Stock (2000)] and [Quick Cast 1]

description.name: HP Stock (2000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 2000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
